forum.title: STM32H747I-DISCO unable to flash in Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS
forum.best_answer_content:
You need to ensure the connection step with CubeProgrammer.

You need to ensure the connection to each of the Cores CM4 and CM7:

To connect to CM7, you need to set the access port to **0**:

![mALLEm_0-1775731172068.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/fbfb618a-f5f3-1694-4a9e-c443fd4dbf30.png "mALLEm_0-1775731172068.png")

To connect to CM4, you need to set the access port to **3**:

![mALLEm_1-1775731234276.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/4c198138-bb28-1f44-5d30-325bd7a3bea4.png "mALLEm_1-1775731234276.png")

Ensure also all the jumpers are set correctly especially JP6: it should be set to ST-LINK option.

If you succeed to connect with CubeProgrammer, try to update the ST-LINK firmware with CubeProgrammer:

![mALLEm_2-1775731355663.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/a45b402c-e2a5-8f32-16bf-4e50e109fcbf.png "mALLEm_2-1775731355663.png")

Then,

![mALLEm_3-1775731424832.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/6072d521-d99d-2cc5-52ec-46125030ca7f.png "mALLEm_3-1775731424832.png")
